name: baxter_ros2_jazzy
postCreateCommand: bash -lc 'source /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.bash && mkdir -p src && if [ ! -d src/baxter_common_ros2 ]; then vcs import src < repos/baxter_core.repos; fi && rosdep install --from-paths src --ignore-src -r -y && colcon build --base-paths src --symlink-install --packages-skip baxter_bridge'
